courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
related.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
related.transfer: 可遷移「完全混合與鹽收支」與「潮交換與淨輸送」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型船閘灌排水系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Complete mixing and salt balance" and "Tidal exchange versus net transport" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略；大型船閘灌排水系統則以從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints; Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks centres on understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「完全混合與鹽收支」與「閘室有效水量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型船閘灌排水系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「射流動量與導流」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Complete mixing and salt balance” and “Effective chamber water volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Jet momentum and redirection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河口鹽水入侵控制
history.text: 河口阻鹽不是單一擋牆問題，淡水流量、潮汐交換、分層與排水功能都會互相影響。一九九一年潮汐水理手冊提供方法背景，二〇一九年美國地質調查局電導章節則強調量測品質。二〇二三年密西西比河低水期間的水下門檻是延緩鹽楔的場址措施，不能改寫成永久消除入侵。艾默伊登主管機關於二〇二五年四月回報，前一年末進入測試的鹽壩對排水影響大於預期，正說明功能互制必須經實測查核。本課合成數據分別練習守恆、分層和損失，不把局部排鹽效率當成整體成效保證。
history.textEn: Estuary salt control is not simply a barrier problem: freshwater flow, tidal exchange, stratification and drainage interact. The1991 tidal manual supplies methodology, while USGS’s2019 conductance chapter emphasizes measurement quality. The2023 Mississippi sill is a site intervention to delay a salt wedge, not permanent elimination of intrusion. In April2025 the IJmuiden authority reported greater-than-expected drainage effects during testing that began late the previous year, demonstrating why coupled functions require observations. Synthetic examples separately examine conservation, stratification and losses; local salt-export efficiency is not presented as a guarantee of successful whole-system performance.
